title: RAND book
action: Watch rows fall; touch and retain a group.
material_fact: Selecting a five-digit group holds it amber while other rows continue; selection does not create the digits.

evidence.claim: Rows descend; selected cells remain visible. This generated page is not a transcription of RAND's historical table.

primary.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
primary.operation: Let the narrative gather a selected group and carry its significance forward.

counterpoint.author: Saidiya Hartman
counterpoint.operation: Keep production, recording and selection distinct; do not fill missing provenance with invention.

refusal: Do not equate digital reduction with the violence constituting archives of slavery.
A number table permits statistical investigation but does not alone establish its physical source.
